lines.text: The attendants propose gathering beautiful young women at Susa, and the one who pleases the king will replace Vashti.
Mordecai, a Jewish man from the tribe of Judah, raised his uncle's daughter Esther because she had no parents.
Esther is placed under Hegai's care and does not reveal her people, because Mordecai instructed her not to.
Each young woman had twelve months of beauty treatments, then visited the king and returned in the morning to Hegai.
Mordecai learned that Bigthan and Teresh plotted against the king, and both were hanged after he told Esther.
